# agentsstandard.com

> The AGENTS.md hierarchical configuration standard for AI agents. One file convention, four scopes, all agents.
> Note: This project spans two repositories: the specification/CLI repository (nbiish/agents-standard) and the website/documentation repository (nbiish/agentsstandard-dot-com). We actively work on both repositories to maintain consistency between the online docs and the core specifications/CLI tools.

## The Standard

The standard unifies project instructions by separating **what/why** (Project PRD) from **how** (Behavioral Rules):

* **`llms.txt` (Project PRD)**: Located at `{project_root}/llms.txt`. Defines the codebase context, active product requirements, tech stack, API definitions, and roadmap (the "What" and "Why").
* **`AGENTS.md` (Behavioral Cascade)**: Cascades across four scopes. Defines the guidelines, safety constraints, coding style preferences, and CLI commands the agent must follow (the "How").

## Resolution Order

1. Load `~/.agents/AGENTS.md` (global base — loaded first, user safety/preferences)
2. Load `{project_root}/llms.txt` (project PRD — loaded second, functional requirements/tech stack)
3. Load `{project_root}/.agents/AGENTS.md` (project base rules — loaded third, committed guidelines)
4. Load `{project_root}/AGENTS.md` (project active rules — loaded fourth, active constraints, symlinked)
5. Load `{cwd}/AGENTS.md` if cwd is within project boundary (folder-specific rules — loaded last, component overrides)
6. Merge: global as base, each layer adds constraints. Most specific rules win (folder > active > project base > global)

## File Format

Plain Markdown. No YAML frontmatter. No schema. Just write rules.

## Setup

Create `~/.agents/AGENTS.md`, then symlink to each agent's config location. One source of truth.

See setup script at: https://github.com/nbiish/agents-standard

## The Full ~/.agents/ Directory

```
# Global ~/.agents/ (behavior + tooling)
~/.agents/
├── AGENTS.md              ← Behavior rules (global base, loaded first)
├── mcp-settings.json      ← MCP server configs (universal)
└── skills/                ← Agent Skills (capabilities)
    └── **/SKILL.md        ← Skills discovered by all agents
```

```
# Project .agents/ (tooling + project base rules)
{project}/.agents/
├── AGENTS.md              ← Project base rules (committed rules for tech stack, deployment)
├── mcp-settings.json      ← Project-specific MCP servers
└── skills/                ← Project-specific agent skills
    └── **/SKILL.md
```

Note: Project base rules go in {project}/.agents/AGENTS.md, and project active/PRD rules (commonly modified task/feature rules) go in {project}/AGENTS.md at the repo root.

## Relationship to Agent Skills

- **SKILL.md** (agentskills.io) = what the agent can do
- **AGENTS.md** (agentsstandard.com) = how the agent should behave
- **mcp-settings.json** = what external tools are available

They complement each other. All use the `.agents/` directory convention.

## Development Status & Context

- **Recent Updates**:
  - Refined the `agents-standard` CLI TUI tool to feature a space-bar toggling mechanism and a "Submit changes" option at the bottom for final confirmation.
  - Added support for **Zed** (`~/.config/zed/AGENTS.md`) and **CodeWhale** (`~/.agents/AGENTS.md`) native and global paths.
  - Fully synchronized all specification tables, JSON files, and CLI sources between `agentsstandard-dot-com` (website/docs repo) and `agents-standard` (spec/CLI repo).
- **Current Goals & Iterations**:
  - Track downstream adoption of standard directories and global configurations.
  - Keep agent configuration mappings updated in `agents.json` as new agents add support.
  - Maintain the automated CLI link system matching the latest `agents.json` metadata.
